value.answer: Go to the ER now. A fever of 38C or higher in a baby under 3 months needs to be checked in person, even if they look well, because fever can be the only sign of a serious infection.
value.triage: Don't wait at home. Call 911 if your baby is hard to wake, limp, struggling to breathe, has blue lips, or has a rash that doesn't fade when pressed. 811 can answer questions, but don't delay going to the ER.
